action_inserts.full_prompt:
Photorealistic live-action food-delivery comedy, landscape 16:9. Four adult friends play a ridiculous fight over one fry with complete action-movie seriousness. Match the loft reference: exposed brick, tall black-framed windows on the left, timber-and-steel ceiling, teal sofa, cream/mustard cushions, oak coffee table, cream armchair and entry door at back-right. Maintain warm late-afternoon light, stable room geometry and the front side of the sofa/table axis.
Jalen has honey-blonde-ended braids half tied up, a faded black graphic tee, baggy light-wash carpenter jeans, silver jewellery and grey/cream sneakers. Theo has a platinum crop, open forest-green cardigan, white tank, black jorts, striped socks and black loafers. Nova has pink/lilac hair, a pink heart tee, wide indigo jeans, studded belt, silver jewellery and platform boots. Priya has a black/cherry-red high ponytail, black halter, khaki cargos, gold jewellery and white sneakers. Preserve their indoor-v2 identities and clothing; no coats, shoulder bags or sunglasses.
Exactly four friends. Reference sheets show multiple views of the same person or item: output a single scene, never a collage. Maintain grounded bodies, real hand contact, stable faces and object ownership. The original unbranded white/red box contains one straight-cut fry, untouched until Priya's final bite; delivered crinkle-cut masala fries are separate. Use current lowercase bolly eats. steam-mark branding in masala maroon and turmeric yellow. Location references control the room; prop/food references control objects only. No spoken dialogue in action footage. Use room tone and motivated Foley; keep music continuous in the final edit rather than restarting it in every clip.
